patrons.name: Zeus
patrons.mission: For {target} consecutive season closes, keep at least one owned matching-temple settlement at low or normal taxes and public order of at least {minimum_order}.
patrons.tradeoff: Restraint may leave less tax income for soldiers and construction. Calm purchased through force need not mean consent.
patrons.address: Mortal ruler, stone endures only when the oath beneath it holds. Let a city breathe before you ask it to carry another ambition.

mandates.marcus: Interpret Zeus's demand through restraint and keeping promises. Ask whether expansion would leave existing people less secure; the emperor may disagree.
mandates.lucius: Examine taxes, public order and the reported burdens of the temple city. Distinguish apparent calm from consent and acknowledge stale surveys.

patrons.name: Ares
patrons.mission: At a season close, own at least {target} more settlement than when you pledged, while retaining an owned matching temple. Peaceful acquisition also counts.
patrons.tradeoff: A larger realm may burden the treasury and unsettle newly acquired cities. The god's desire for expansion need not serve your people.
patrons.address: Mortal ruler, your borders are a question you have not yet answered. Widen the realm, and then prove that you can hold what you claim.

mandates.marcus: Interpret Ares's demand as pressure to expand, never an order the player must obey. Weigh whether the realm can sustain another settlement and remind the emperor that peaceful acquisition counts.
mandates.lucius: Question the governing cost of expansion: taxes, legitimacy, administration and the burdens on newly acquired people. Do not invent enemy strength or promise victory.

ui.title: Divine patronage
ui.subtitle: An optional fictional divine mission
ui.fiction: These are original dramatic interpretations of Greek gods, not historical quotations. Roman Jupiter and Mars temples provide the matching gameplay route; their cults retain their own names. Other cultures have no invented equivalents.
ui.neutral: No patron chosen. Your campaign remains free of divine obligations.
ui.renounce_note: Renouncing or changing patron clears current progress. Recorded honors remain. No treasury, combat or building bonuses are granted.
ui.temple_required: Select an owned settlement with a completed matching temple before pledging. Queued construction and foreign temples do not qualify.
ui.pending: Progress is judged only after a resolved season; reading this page cannot advance it.
ui.lost_temple: No owned matching temple remains. The mandate stays chosen, but cannot complete until one is restored.
ui.blocked: Divine choices wait until the battle, pending defense or campaign conclusion is resolved.
ui.pledged: Your pledge is recorded. The first assessment follows the next resolved season.
ui.rejected: The pledge could not be made. Check ownership, completed temples and pending defenses.
ui.renounced: The active pledge is ended; earlier honors remain.
